text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The royal road where champion steeds gather.
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year again, Nakayama Racecourse is packed
with racing fans eagerly waiting
for the emergence of a new star.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooooh—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...The clamor echoing into the waiting room like this has a different charm compared to hearing it from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Even I... feel somewhat stirred by today's race.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm able to run in the Satsuki Sho...
a race that Big Sis never got to run in."
choice_data_list: ...Let's burn today's scenery into our memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This Satsuki Sho is,
in every sense, a giant leap forward
for Dream Journey's voyage."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, that also meant running the races that Stay Gold couldn't.
That's why—
choice_data_list: And let's run for her sake as well

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Let us run this Satsuki Sho for "Big Sis's" sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The smile Dream Journey showed
as she walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It felt as though it harbored
something different than usual—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey!
Give it your all out there today!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text: Show me what it's like to win a Classic race!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (...It seems I have a steady number of fans supporting me even in the Classic Class.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(A banner meant for me, huh...
Still, that message...—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
""Stay Gold: Chapter Two"...
"And So the Dream Journey Begins"...――"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Even if we walk different paths... they still see their 'Big Sis' in me, don't they...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Then, I shall let you witness it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Today's journey of mine—)
